scoreRequired: A pass needs a score: a whole number from 0 to 100
scoreRequiredFor: A pass needs a score: a whole number from 0 to {max}
usageEyebrowStudent: Credits you used on this challenge
usageModeRank: A rank-based credit score is finalised at the challenge deadline and the total updates with it; before then a submitted review shows a provisional total.

usageRuleRank: By class rank: the less you used, the higher you score; finalised at the deadline
usageRuleThreshold: By threshold: up to {full} credits scores full marks, {zero} credits scores 0, in between pro-rated
